description: Self-authored focused render comparisons. These are not the Web Platform Tests and do not establish browser conformance.

cases.name: overflow-clip
cases.description: Overflow clips descendants at the padding edge and restores clipping for a following sibling.

cases.name: fractional-grid-gap
cases.description: Fractional grid tracks share space in a 1:2 ratio after subtracting a gap.

cases.name: box-model
cases.description: Content width/height, padding, solid border and margins produce the specified outer rectangle.

cases.name: cascade-inheritance
cases.description: An important selector beats inline color; descendants inherit font size and selected children override color.

cases.name: flex-grow-gap
cases.description: Flex distributes remaining width in a 1:2 ratio after subtracting the inter-item gap.

cases.name: grid-tracks
cases.description: Two explicit grid column tracks and a gap place four cells in two rows.

cases.name: hidden-template
cases.description: Hidden attributes, display:none subtrees and template contents contribute no paint or flow height.

cases.name: preformatted-lines
cases.description: Preformatted spaces and an explicit newline retain spaces and use the specified line height.

cases.name: table-default-spacing
cases.description: The implicit tbody and two rows use explicit cell widths with the default 2px table spacing.

cases.name: media-custom-properties
cases.description: A matching screen-width media rule selects a custom property used by the background shorthand.
